title: Covered Balance and Down Payment of a Home-Site Lease Repayment Agreement
content:
**Collections rule — down payment on a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement**

1. **Covered balance.** The balance the agreement covers is the amount demanded by the most recent nonpayment notice on the lease.
2. **Down payment.** The lot class's minimum down-payment percentage of the covered balance, rounded half up to the cent.

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Covered balance | the amount demanded on the most recent nonpayment notice among the lease's notices |
| Percentage | the lot class's minimum down-payment percentage |

The covered balance is the notice's figure, not the lease balance on the signing date: charges or payments posted after the notice do not change it.

**Worked figures (hypothetical minimum percentage of 30.0)**

| Most recent nonpayment notice demands | Down payment in words | Down payment |
|---|---|---|
| 1,482.50 | 30.0 percent of 1,482.50 | 444.75 |
| 1,203.37 | 30.0 percent of 1,203.37 is 361.011, rounded half up | 361.01 |
| 980.05 | 30.0 percent of 980.05 is 294.015, rounded half up | 294.02 |

*Which notice governs when the lease carries more than one nonpayment notice?* The most recent one.
